newsitem.title: USA: Telco Comms files suit against AT&T.
newsitem.headline: Telco Comms files suit against AT&T.

text.p: Telco Communications Group Inc said on Thrusday that it petitioned a federal district court in Virginia to stop AT&T from making alleged false claims against Telco's Lang Distance Wholesale Club.
The company said it filed suit in the Alexandria division of the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Virginia.
Telco said that it is also seeking damages from a lawsuit AT&T filed aginst the company, that it says is frivolous.
Telco said that in December, AT&T had filed a lawsuit accusing its Long Distance Wholesale Club of false and misleading advertising.
A spokesman for AT&T said that the company stands by the claims it make in its lawsuit against Telco.
"We haven't seen the lawsuit (filed by Telco), but we stand by the claim in our lawsuit filed December 18 that Telco's advertising is false and misleading," the spokesman said.
